reason: The decision content is correct but not new: no finals change, the non-x138 F2 stays closed, and both partners (#37 56563521 and exp75 56656157 = #37 + CI) lack cap 6 and K (card_fill_1203_v2.txt l.28). R37-A4 (PC37-07, corrected) already says all of this in a hedged optional line. What this finding adds is its claim that Satwik's premise is 'not supported', and that claim is overclaimed. (1) Probe 26 (RESULTS.md l.59: exp29 0.947 -> exp45 safe divisions OFF 0.911, J_pub 0.36) measures a RATIO. It cannot test a COUNT claim ('very few divisions'), because J = 0.36 fits a denominator of 20 as well as 150. (2) The '1-2 events' quantization assumes TP+FP+FN = 50-150. DC 0.30's -0.005 (exp70d 0.949 vs 0.954 in ledger.md) is also exactly 1 event at a denominator of ~20. The +0.001/+0.002 steps may partly be edge or node-bonus moves: K alone adds 3 safe forks + 1 insertion (CONTEXT l.3579-3582), and the rounding is 0.001. So our probes cannot resolve Satwik's premise either way. The honest wording is 'our probes cannot check this', not 'not confirmed by our probes'. The proposed card sentence also gives the user a new unverified number ('1–2 деления'), and it puts '~0.036' next to 'мало делений', which reads as a contradiction but is not one. The line is optional and has no decision impact, so the rewording is worth roughly nothing and carries a small confusion risk. One real issue remains, and R37-A4 already covers it: scratchpad card_fill_1203_v2.txt l.54 still has the stale 'Это довод за страховку #37.', which must go before 12:03Z.
